# Coconote

> > Coconote is an AI-powered note-taking app that transforms lectures and audio into organized notes, flashcards, and quizzes for students.

Coconote is a student-focused productivity platform that leverages AI to automate note-taking from lectures, podcasts, and recordings. The app is available across iOS, Android, and web platforms, helping students study more efficiently with generated flashcards and quiz tools.

## Key Topics

- AI note-taking
- Lecture recording
- Flashcard generation
- Quiz generation
- Study tools
- Transcription
- iOS app
- Android app
- Multi-language support
- Podcast notes
- Student productivity
- Education technology
- ADHD-friendly
- Lecture notes
